- No exclusion keywords (e.g., "Mahnung", "Zahlungserinnerung") dominating header — proceed as invoice.

2) Locate fields

3) Conversions and number formats
- Input uses comma as decimal separator. Convert to numeric form preserving decimals and decimal count: "5.213,69" -> 5213.69, "4.739,72" -> 4739.72, "473,97" -> 473.97.
- VAT rate extract without percent sign: "10,00%" -> 10.00 -> represent as number 10 (or 10.00 preserving decimals per input). Schema accepts number.

4) Missing fields check
- Confirm all required schema fields present in document: GrandTotal.Amount (Rechnungsbetrag), Invoice.Date, Sender.VatId, Vat.Rate, Net.Amount, Vat.Amount — all available.

- GrandTotal.Amount as number 5213.69
- Invoice.Date as string "09.01.2024" (exact format from document)
- Sender.VatId as "ATU23264205"
